// divguard:path agent/agent.go

package agent

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"io"
	"time"
)

type Options struct {
	MaxTurns int
	Timeout  time.Duration
}

// NewAgent reproduces the silent turn cap that shipped on main.
func NewAgent(opts Options) Options {
	if opts.MaxTurns == 0 {
		opts.MaxTurns = 100 // want
	}
	return opts
}

const connectTimeout = 10 * time.Second // want

func run(ctx context.Context, r io.Reader) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 250*time.Millisecond) // want
	defer cancel()
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(r)
	sc.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 1024), 16<<20)  // want
	reader := bufio.NewReaderSize(r, 64*1024) // want
	_ = reader
	_ = Options{Timeout: time.Second} // want
	turns := 0
	if turns >= 50 { // want
		return
	}
	// upstream: agent/src/agent-loop.ts:runLoop
	retryDelay := 3 * time.Second // want
	_ = retryDelay
	maxQueue := 64 // want
	_ = maxQueue
	<-ctx.Done()
}
